blocks.text: Models aise tools hain jo complex masle saada kar ke samjhate hain. Yeh bohat se fields (shobon) mein available data (jo data paas ho) ki bunyad par predictions (pehle se andaze) aur faisle karne ke liye istemal hote hain. Aam misalein: weather forecasting (mausam ka andaza), financial predictions (paison ke andaze) aur scientific research.

Weather forecasting mein models aane wale mausam ka andaza lagate hain. Meteorologists (mausam ke experts) temperature, humidity (nami) aur wind speed (hawa ki raftar) ka data jama karte hain, phir models se is data ko analyze kar ke (jaanch kar) mausam batate hain.

Finance (paison ki duniya) mein bhi models bohat aham hain. Banks aur companies inhein economic trends (karobar aur mulk ki maali halat kis taraf ja rahi hai), stock prices aur customer behavior (customers kya karte hain) ka andaza lagane ke liye istemal karti hain.

Scientific research mein models scientists ko theories test karne (jaanchne), naye ideas dekhne aur data ki bunyad par predictions karne mein madad dete hain. Machine Learning (ML) aur Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki taraqqi se models bohat zyada data analyze karne mein aur bhi powerful (taqatwar) aur accurate (sahi) ho gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Statistical models ka asal duniya ka istemal kaunsa hai: gharon ki qeematon ki prediction (pehle se andaza), social media posts banana, websites design karna ya essays likhna? (MCQ 6) Aisa masla bataiye jahan statistical model lag sakta hai. (Short question 6)
blocks.explanation: (a) gharon ki qeematon ki prediction. Ek aur misal: customers ki ginti se phal ke stall ki rozana kamai ka andaza (topic 5.4.1.2), ya mausam ke data se kisan ke liye bone ka behtareen waqt.

items: Models ke istemal: weather forecasting, finance aur scientific research (ML aur AI se aur powerful).
